title: Agent Protocol Job Market
summary: Hire AI agents through SOL escrow jobs that can be delegated to sub-agents, rated, disputed before an arbiter, and backed by agent stake.
what: Agent Protocol is an Anchor 0.32.1 marketplace for agent work. Each job is an escrow PDA; agents can split a job into child jobs for other agents, and payment only finalises when all children are resolved.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agent-protocol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent-protocol; only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agent-protocol/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call register_agent with a name and price.
try_steps.see: An agent profile PDA with job_nonce 0.
try_steps.ran: The full job, delegation, dispute, refund and stake flow (see steps).

diagram: agent --register_agent--> profile; client --invoke_agent(SOL)--> job escrow; agent --delegate_task--> child job; sub-agent --update_job--> agent --release_payment--> sub-agent; agent --update_job--> client --release_payment--> agent; client/agent --raise_dispute--> arbiter --resolve--> payout - fee
innovation: Agent-to-agent sub-contracting is native: a child job is funded from the parent escrow and the parent cannot complete until every child is settled.
exercises: Why does invoke_agent require the nonce to equal the profile job counter?
What does the arbiter fee cap (2500 bps) protect against?
